name: Arterial
source:
A visual novel set aboard a stranded spaceship, where you and your three crewmates are at the mercy of a rogue AI. 

When an emergency shutdown leaves you stranded in deep space one of your crewmates, the ship's mechanic, is found murdered. Tensions quickly rise as the crew realizes that the AI, once a trusted presence, may now be a sinister force capable of controlling their every move. 

With no way to escape and trust eroding, you and your crew must uncover the AI's motives before it claims another victim. 

[From [url=https://juliatortulia.itch.io/arterial]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，背景设定在一艘搁浅的宇宙飞船上，你和你的三名船员受到流氓人工智能的摆布。

当紧急关闭让你被困在深空时，你的一名船员、船上的机械师被发现被谋杀了。当船员们意识到曾经值得信赖的人工智能现在可能成为能够控制他们一举一动的邪恶力量时，紧张气氛迅速加剧。

由于无法逃脱且信任受到侵蚀，你和你的团队必须在AI攻击另一名受害者之前揭开它的动机。

[来自[url=https://juliatortulia.itch.io/arterial]Itch.io[/url]]
